lessons.title: Cirilo Saucedo: Club and country
lessons.subtitle: A youth medal, a senior debut, and the move to Xolos

story.title: A medal with Mexico’s under-23s
story.body: Before his long top-flight career, Cirilo Saucedo also represented Mexico at youth level. Club Tijuana’s profile notes that he was part of the Mexico under-23 squad that won bronze at the 2003 Pan American Games in Santo Domingo.

story.title: From Tigres to a Mexico debut
story.body: Club Tijuana announced Saucedo’s arrival from Tigres UANL ahead of Apertura 2011, its first top-flight tournament. In January 2013 he made his senior Mexico debut in a friendly against Denmark. These are two distinct career steps: a club move in 2011 and a senior international debut in 2013.
